graph.name: Make a scene brief
graph.description:
Write a small reusable instruction for the next reply using two nodes and no auxiliary call.

Lesson: Connect matching Guidance pins, inspect a deterministic artifact, and distinguish Preview from enabled Send publication.

Limitations: A literal brief is optional writing direction; it has no automatic awareness of changes in the chat.

Opening makes this example the active workflow document. Bind local model roles and provide the documented evidence before running.

Pre: at most 0 auxiliary calls. Preview before publishing or applying.

Try changing:
Replace shelter with a practical task Mira can offer; preview the literal brief before generating prose.
Set budgetTokens below the measured token estimate; observe GUIDANCE_OVERFLOW and no publication, then shorten Direction and rerun.

Documentation specimen (does not seed chat or actor memory):

Situation: The ferry gate is closed. Mira carries an unopened letter.

Guidance: At the closed ferry gate, Mira can explain the delay or offer shelter. Keep the unopened letter sealed. End with a question or NPC action that leaves the player free to answer; do not supply the player’s decision.

One typed connection: brief.out → publish.in. Two nodes, one Guidance wire, zero auxiliary calls. Edit Direction to adapt the scenario.

Ferry gate · open decision (brief)
Purpose: Supply a visible authored instruction with no model dependency.
Inspect: Run to here shows literal text. Direction is editable content, not a context scanner.

Offer ferry-gate guidance (publish)
Purpose: Bound the brief at the root output.
Inspect: Inspect the full root preview. Publication uses the ordinary open and enabled native-send path; previewing writes no event.
